name: Calme de Couraciel
original_name: カルム・ド・クラーシェル
source:
The older brother of Rex and captain of the Exlattle Knight Order.

Serious and disciplined, he values rules and earns the deep trust of those around him. Though often troubled by his younger brother’s impulsive behavior, he cares for him deeply from the bottom of his heart.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/crazy_chain/chara/]official website[/url]]
